title: Recruiter
description:
Job Title:Recruiter – Talent Acquisition

Company: Bajaj Life Insurance Ltd.

Location: Ecospace,new town,kolkata (On site)

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: 19000-22000+ Incentives]

Bajaj Life Insurance Ltd. is one of India’s leading private life insurance companies. A joint venture between Bajaj We are committed to transforming the life insurance landscape through digital innovation, customer-centric solutions, and a high-performance workforce.

Job Summary

We are seeking a results-driven Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you will lead end-to-end recruitment for front-line sales executive roles, agency channels, financial consultants, and operational teams. You will play a critical role in scaling our workforce, sourcing quality talent, and maintaining seamless candidate engagement.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Recruitment: Manage the complete hiring lifecycle including sourcing, pre-screening, interview scheduling, assessment, and offer execution.

High-Volume Sourcing: Proactively source candidates using job portals (Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri), local referral channels, social media, and walk-in drives.

Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate with Branch Managers to understand headcount mandates and fulfill hiring timelines.

Agent & Agency Channel Onboarding: Support the recruitment and documentation process for Insurance Consultants and Agency Partners across branches.

Screening & Shortlisting: Evaluate candidate fit based on sales aptitude, communication skills, and financial domain knowledge.

Data Management & Reporting: Track daily recruitment metrics, update internal databases, and submit hiring pipelines to regional leads.

Key Requirements

Experience: Experience & fresher both can apply for the position (OJT provided)

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Any Stream; MBA/PGDM in HR is a plus.

Skills: Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Strong ability to manage target-driven recruitment quotas.

Tools: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and hands-on experience with Job Portals and ATS platforms.

Benefits

Performance-linked monthly/quarterly incentives

Provident Fund (PF) and Gratuity benefits

Structured learning and career advancement pathways

Pay: ₹19,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Non IT Recruiter
description:
About STEM Learning

STEM Learning Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's leading organizations driving educational transformation through

STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering & Mathematics) programs. We partner with corporates,

government bodies, schools, and CSR organizations to create impactful learning experiences across the

country.

We are looking for a passionate and performance-driven Recruiter to join our HR team and support our

growing hiring needs across India.

Role Overview

The Recruiter will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle for Non-IT positions

across multiple functions. The role requires strong sourcing capabilities, stakeholder management, and the

ability to close positions within defined timelines.

Candidates with recruitment experience in the CSR, NGO, Education, Social Impact, Manufacturing, or

Corporate sector are welcome to apply. Experience in the CSR/Education domain will be an added

advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end recruitment for Non-IT positions across PAN India.

Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and hiring priorities.

Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, social media, employee referrals, networking,

and database searches.

Conduct resume screening, telephonic interviews, and candidate assessments.

Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and ensure timely feedback.

Manage salary negotiations, offer rollouts, documentation, and onboarding coordination.

Build and maintain a healthy talent pipeline for critical and recurring roles.

Track recruitment metrics, maintain hiring MIS, and ensure adherence to recruitment TATs.

Deliver an excellent candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.

Eligibility

Bachelor's degree in any discipline.

2+ years of experience in end-to-end Non-IT recruitment.

1

Experience hiring for Sales, CSR, Corporate Partnerships, Operations, HR, Finance, Administration,

Manufacturing, Education, or other business functions.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong sourcing, interviewing, and negotiation skills.

Ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.

Proficiency in MS Office and recruitment platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and Indeed.

Preferred

Experience in the CSR, NGO, Education, or Social Impact sector.

Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work with one of India's leading STEM education organizations.

Exposure to nationwide hiring across diverse business functions.

A collaborative, fast-paced, and growth-oriented work environment.

Opportunities for professional learning and career progression.

Important Note

Location: Kolkata (Work from Office).

Candidates must own a personal laptop and will be required to use it during the probation period.

Company-issued IT assets will be provided after successful confirmation, in line with company policy

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹43,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
WE ARE HIRING | TALENT ACQUISITION / IT RECRUITER

**Location:** Tollygunge / Kudghat, Kolkata  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Salary:** Up to ₹35,000 per month  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an experienced IT Recruiter / Talent Acquisition professional with strong IT staffing expertise and an active network of candidates and clients.

* Strong experience in IT Recruitment / IT Staffing
* Existing client relationships / active client accounts
* Strong LinkedIn network and professional connections
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Good understanding of IT technologies and technical job descriptions
* Strong candidate sourcing, screening, and coordination skills

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage end-to-end IT recruitment
* Source, screen, and shortlist qualified IT candidates
* Understand client requirements and manage candidate submissions
* Maintain and strengthen existing client relationships
* Manage client accounts and generate new IT requirements
* Coordinate interviews, offers, and joining formalities
* Drive recruitment closures and meet hiring targets
* Use LinkedIn, job portals, and Boolean search for candidate sourcing

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

* IT Recruitment Consultancy / Staffing experience
* Permanent, Contract, and Contract-to-Hire recruitment experience
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter
* Strong client acquisition and account management skills

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
**Job Title:** Talent Acquisition \& Business Assistant to Director

**Location:** Remote (Kolkata\-based for periodic in\-person meetings)

**Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a versatile, proactive professional to drive talent recruitment, acquire new clients, and provide high\-level executive support to the Director. While this is primarily a work\-from\-home role, you must reside in or near Lucknow for occasional mandatory in\-person syncs and strategic reporting.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing top candidates to interviewing and onboarding.
* Drive new client acquisition by identifying leads, pitching services, and closing business deals.
* Act as a direct assistant to the Director, managing schedules, communications, and administrative tasks.
* Travel locally to Lucknow office/locations periodically for performance reporting and director syncs.

**Requirements:**

* Proven track record in recruitment/HR and business development/sales.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and time\-management skills.
* Self\-motivated with a reliable home\-office setup and willingness to visit Lucknow as required.

Pay: ₹9,461\.34 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kolkata, West Bengal
